title: Shadow of the Clock Tower  (Sombra da Torre do Relógio)

segments.t: Às cinco para o meio-dia, {Hannah} e {Caleb} chegam à ensolarada praça da torre do relógio municipal enquanto {Arthur} recupera o fôlego num degrau próximo. {Owen} acena calorosamente ao se aproximar em seu intervalo de tarefas de sábado. Ouça primeiro.
{Hannah}! {Caleb}! What brings our courtyard crew up to the clock tower square?
We are following thirty-year-old map clues from a tin box under our courtyard tree!
You arrived at the exact right minute, big brother—watch the tall clock hands above.
One minute to twelve... listen, there goes the first deep bronze chime!
Card Two says: Stand where the noon shadow touches a stone star on the ground.
Follow the dark tip of the tower shadow across the paving stones with me!
Right here beside the lamppost base—someone carved a small four-point star!
And look at the arrow on the longest point of the star—it aims back south!
What does Clue Card Three say about heading south toward the middle of Linden Street?
Where second-hand stories sleep beneath a cool stone arch, look up at eye level!
That is definitely the old second-hand bookshop with the arched stone doorway!
Let us collect {Arthur} and {Evelyn}—the bookshop arch is only four minutes away!
Agora vamos repassar a conversa com calma, frase por frase.
{Hannah}! {Caleb}! What brings our courtyard crew up to the clock tower square?
'Hannah! Caleb! O que traz a turma do nosso pátio até a praça da torre do relógio?'
We are following thirty-year-old map clues from a tin box under our courtyard tree!
'Estamos seguindo pistas de mapa de trinta anos atrás de uma caixa de lata que estava sob a árvore do nosso pátio!'
You arrived at the exact right minute, big brother—watch the tall clock hands above.
'Você chegou no minuto exato e certo, irmãozão — observe os ponteiros altos do relógio lá no alto.'
One minute to twelve... listen, there goes the first deep bronze chime!
'Um minuto para o meio-dia... escute, lá vai a primeira badalada grave de bronze!'
Card Two says: Stand where the noon shadow touches a stone star on the ground.
'O Cartão Dois diz: Fique onde a sombra do meio-dia toca uma estrela de pedra no chão.'
Follow the dark tip of the tower shadow across the paving stones with me!
'Acompanhe a ponta escura da sombra da torre pelas pedras do calçamento comigo!'
Right here beside the lamppost base—someone carved a small four-point star!
'Bem aqui, ao lado da base do poste de luz — alguém esculpiu uma pequena estrela de quatro pontas!'
And look at the arrow on the longest point of the star—it aims back south!
'E olhe para a seta na ponta mais longa da estrela — ela aponta de volta para o sul!'
What does Clue Card Three say about heading south toward the middle of Linden Street?
'O que o Cartão de Pista Três diz sobre seguir para o sul em direção ao meio da Rua Linden?'
Where second-hand stories sleep beneath a cool stone arch, look up at eye level!
'Onde histórias de segunda mão dormem sob um arco de pedra fria, olhe para cima na altura dos olhos!'
That is definitely the old second-hand bookshop with the arched stone doorway!
'Aquela é definitivamente a antiga livraria de usados com a porta de pedra em arco!'
Let us collect {Arthur} and {Evelyn}—the bookshop arch is only four minutes away!
'Vamos reunir o Arthur e a Evelyn — o arco da livraria fica a apenas quatro minutos de distância!'
Vamos ouvir toda a cena novamente em velocidade natural.

You arrived at the exact right minute, big brother—watch the tall clock hands above.
One minute to twelve... listen, there goes the first deep bronze chime!
Card Two says: Stand where the noon shadow touches a stone star on the ground.
Follow the dark tip of the tower shadow across the paving stones with me!
Right here beside the lamppost base—someone carved a small four-point star!
And look at the arrow on the longest point of the star—it aims back south!
What does Clue Card Three say about heading south toward the middle of Linden Street?
Where second-hand stories sleep beneath a cool stone arch, look up at eye level!
That is definitely the old second-hand bookshop with the arched stone doorway!
Let us collect {Arthur} and {Evelyn}—the bookshop arch is only four minutes away!
As doze badaladas do meio-dia soam por toda a Portland, e a sombra da torre do relógio aponta nossa equipe diretamente para o arco do sebo. Até a próxima.
See you soon!
